_about: Generation sheet for ElevenLabs sound effects. One entry per Sfx id (docs/arquitetura.md 7.8). Output: assets/audio/sfx/<id>.ogg, mono. duration_s is the requested length (min 0.5). loop=true only for ambience.
style: Realistic field recording, dry, no music, no voice, no reverb tail beyond what is stated, single clean take.
